customer_name: Penghua Fund Management Co., Ltd. (鹏华基金管理有限公司)
business_problem: Penghua Fund needed to reduce manual work in research, operations, and compliance tasks such as classifying financial events, summarizing announcements and meetings, checking fund-style drift, and answering internal knowledge questions from large document collections.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Penghua Fund built a financial large-model application layer on top of Qianfan and the BaiGe heterogeneous compute platform. The implementation packaged mature large-model capabilities for text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and document retrieval into eight business scenarios spanning research, operations, and office workflows. Through the Base Zhihui financial APaaS workbench, Penghua created visual prompt templates, tuned business logic, and assembled an internal AI application marketplace with twenty skills. The resulting Penghua Wenxin platform integrates market intelligence, A-share announcement summaries, report briefs, internal rules, and product knowledge so analysts and staff can query a shared knowledge layer, retrieve cited answers, and automate repetitive reading and classification tasks without rebuilding models for every department.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the core large-model capabilities for classification, summarization, extraction, and question answering.

solution_components.name: BaiGe Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the compute environment used to run Penghua's financial large-model workloads.

solution_components.name: Base Zhihui Agent (Financial APaaS Platform)
solution_components.role: Gives business teams a visual workbench to manage prompts, debug scenarios, and package reusable AI skills.

solution_components.name: Penghua Wenxin Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the user-facing service layer for research, office, and document-intelligence applications inside the fund manager.

solution_components.name: Internal Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Stores policies, reports, products, and internal procedures so the models can retrieve grounded answers for employees.

data_flow: News, listed-company announcements, meeting notes, internal rules, product documents, and research reports are processed through Qianfan services running on BaiGe. Base Zhihui packages the prompts and skills for each scenario, and the Penghua Wenxin platform serves summaries, classifications, and knowledge-grounded answers back to analysts and operations staff through a shared internal marketplace.
business_outcome: Penghua Fund accelerated analyst and operations work, raised the quality of internal Q&A, and created a reusable financial AI service layer that can support more business teams without starting from scratch for each use case.
metrics: Fund managers save more than 30% of the time previously spent gathering market intelligence.
The internal Q&A assistant resolves more than 90% of questions.
The internal AI application marketplace includes 20 skills across 8 business scenarios.
architecture_clues: Eight scenarios span financial event analysis, style-drift judgment, announcement summaries, meeting summaries, internal policy Q&A, element extraction, product retrieval, and report Q&A.
Prompt templates are managed visually through the financial APaaS workbench.
The knowledge-base system is connected to the large-model platform so underlying data can be updated with business changes.
The solution packages reusable skills into an internal application marketplace rather than building one-off assistants.
